data.title: 65km of Freedom: Your Morning, Your Way, No Bus Required.
data.body: Skip the bus and the stress. The iENYRID M4 Pro S+ Max delivers up to 65km range, a comfy seat, and 45km/h speed. Cruise to campus with zero hassle. Back-to-school just got a serious upgrade. 🛴 Grab yours now at iENYRID!
data.xText: Late for class? The iENYRID M4 Pro S+ Max gets you there fast—up to 65km range, smooth ride, and a seat for comfort. Back-to-school mode activated. 🛴 Shop now: https://www.ienyrid-eu.com/products/ienyrid-m4-pro-s-max-800w-electric-scooter-with-seat-20ah
data.imagePrompt: A young student in casual back-to-school attire rides the iENYRID M4 Pro S+ Max electric scooter on a clean, modern city street. Morning golden hour light casts warm tones. In the background, contemporary office and campus buildings. The scooter's seat is clearly visible, emphasizing comfort. The student carries a backpack, looking confident and relaxed. Composition: dynamic low-angle shot showing speed and freedom. Mood: energetic, fresh, back-to-school vibes. Tire details and sleek black design highlighted. No clutter, just pure urban commute aesthetic.
